_about: Career-group folders. A video lives in content/<id>/<name>/, videos/<id>/<name>/ and kichban/<id>/. Add a group here before using its folder; scripts/validate-storyboard.mjs checks storyboard paths against this list. safetySensitive groups follow CLAUDE.md's rules for safety-sensitive careers.
